Home/Capabilities

Services & capabilities

Advanced connectivity solutions
for sustained performance.

Design and engineering, connector manufacturing, cable and harness assembly, PCBA, full system assembly and overmolded cables – six disciplines under one group, so a product never has to change hands mid-way.

What we do

Six disciplines, one production chain.

Design and Engineering

More than 30 years of assembling, which led us to design the cables, connectors and harnesses ourselves.

Connector Manufacturing

More than 15 years designing and producing connectors in cooperation with Kenpol.

Cable and Harness Assembly

Five manufacturing sites in Israel, Thailand and India, and more than 300 operators.

PCBA

PCB assembly for the aerospace, medical and telecommunication industries.

System Assembly

A wide range of assembly services for fully assembled systems and products.

Overmolded Cables

Advanced machinery and tools for molding, as part of our cable assembly production capabilities.

Why it matters

One supplier means one accountability.

The collaborative and adaptive assembly process allows us to work closely with our partners to create tailored solutions that align with their product requirements.

Customer satisfaction is the cornerstone of our business. Our management team provides support at every stage of the process, from initial consultation to post-sale assistance.

ISO 9001Quality management, certified at every manufacturing site in the group
ISO 13485Medical devices – ISO 13485:2016
AS9100DThe aerospace industry quality standard

Engineered connectivity for medical, aerospace and industrial technology – since 1993.
